source.citation: Molenaar, A. P. (1996) freeze-bond / ice-structure interaction test programme (freshwater ice on mild steel, displacement-controlled pull-off and shear tests)

provenance.note: NOT point-digitized originals. Peak forces, initial stiffness, post-peak separations and the failure-mode transition interval were taken from the reported ranges above; the individual coordinates of the two F-u curves were reconstructed to be consistent with those ranges (peak, initial slope, area) and carry a deliberate ~2-5% shape deviation from the bilinear cohesive law so that the shape test is not tautological. Every number computed against this file is a comparison against a DECLARED ANCHOR, not against measured data. Replace this file with a true digitization to upgrade the evidence grade from WITHHELD to REAL; the comparison machinery needs no change.
provenance.how_to_upgrade: write the digitized (u_um, F_N) coordinates and peak_tests rows measured in the source, keep the same schema, set provenance.digitization='point_digitized' and provenance.evidence_grade='REAL'

transition.note: bracketed by the warmest cohesive and the coldest adhesive peak test; the band is the bracket half-width, both bracketing points are flagged in_transition_band and excluded from the mode-agreement score
